intent_en: To validate the use of objective standards in pretrial decisions by presenting encouraging data on defendant compliance and public safety.
previous_intent: To demonstrate the effectiveness of objective pretrial release standards in DC courts by highlighting that the majority of released defendants return to court and avoid arrest.
chart_support: Horizontal bar chart showing high proportions of defendants released pretrial who returned for court and were not arrested in 2017.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly states the data is encouraging and aims for objective standards, while the chart visualizes high success rates for release, court appearance, and lack of arrest.
